companion.title: Corrective coverage
companion.caption: A-B, Actual gene and frozen nonself TF-target-pair coverage for all 18 verified inference tasks in three corrective contexts. Green marks the registered gate met (at least 90% frozen genes in A, exactly 100% finite frozen pairs in B); gray marks an observed coverage gate not met. C, Independently replayed undefined co-expression genes in each context. D, Complete final analysis admission: 4/4 denotes all own/none x restricted/unrestricted slots measured for that context/readout; Model, Baseline and Both denote verified model-coverage, undefined-baseline or combined exclusions. No pending task is classified as excluded. Preparation, inference and final analysis receipts and independent complete snapshots are required before release. Undefined scores are not zero-imputed, and coverage admission is not a zero-effect finding, donor interval or pretraining exclusion.
